_comment: Academic Studio 'Recommended Plugins' catalog (offline snapshot). Live version served at https://academic-studio.com/plugins.json; the app fetches it on startup and in Run Setup, so curating plugins = edit site/plugins.json + push (GitHub Pages deploys site/**). Each entry is declarative data — a git source installed as a Claude skill via `npx skills add`, plus optional pip libs — the app never executes shell text from this file. Keep this snapshot in sync with site/plugins.json.

packages.label: Smithers — your email and calendar desk: inbox split into what needs a reply, a 7-day calendar, tasks, and a Compose tab; Claude Code writes your morning briefing, drafts replies you review and send, and proposes calendar changes you confirm
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: smithers

packages.label: Cardstock — HTML, PDF (and PPTX image-only) slides via Quarto and Decktape. Default styling replaces lists with colored cards. Tell Claude to change styling to whatever you like
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: cardstock

packages.label: Critique — simple skill to evaluate AI text output. Instructs Claude to use three subagents to critique from different perspectives; then the main agent integrates and prioritizes
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: critique

packages.label: Finance Data — fetch market & economic data (Yahoo Finance, FRED, SEC EDGAR, Ken French, FinnHub, Financial Modeling Prep) and save as CSV
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: finance-data

packages.label: LitDB — library management tool for research papers and your notes; add PDFs and search their full text by keyword & meaning, find new work (OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar), track citations, export BibTeX; optional Zotero
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: litdb

packages.label: Voiceover Builder — narrate a slide deck into an MP4 video + transcript (Claude writes the narration into your .qmd/.pptx speaker notes, ElevenLabs voices it)
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: voiceover

packages.label: Participation — record class participation: a 1-3 score for amount and quality against each student, saved to participation.csv in the class folder. Needs only a list of names; photos optional
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: participation

packages.label: Screen Share — put a student's screen on the classroom projector: students join from an https link on their own laptops, pick a screen, window or tab, and you choose who is shown. Needs cloudflared, under Supporting programs
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: screenshare

packages.label: Poll — put a question to the class on the projector: type /poll followed by the question and it goes up immediately, or /poll <file> for one written before class. Multiple choice, word clouds, confidence scales, numeric estimates, rankings. Students answer anonymously from their own devices. Needs cloudflared, under Supporting programs
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: poll

packages.label: WRDS — connection code, query building blocks, twelve WRDS (Drechsler) reference scripts, and the competing Ken French / Drechsler / OpenAP conventions written out and compared, for pulling and constructing CRSP, Compustat, and IBES data
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: wrds

packages.label: Research Setup — structure a research repo that several people and their Claudes can share: per-author folders, portable paths, one canonical dataset, provenance (what produced this / what breaks if I change it), a round lock, and a generated CLAUDE.md that makes it self-explaining
packages.author: Kerry Back
packages.name: research-setup

packages.label: Econ Slides — turn an economics paper into a Beamer talk with a timed speaker script
packages.author: Lu Han (OpenEconAI)
packages.name: econ-slides

packages.label: Econ Writing — write, edit, restructure, and audit economics papers with field-aware guidance
packages.author: Lu Han (OpenEconAI)
packages.name: econ-write

packages.label: Econ Paper Review — a rigorous referee report and prioritized revision plan for an economics paper
packages.author: Lu Han (OpenEconAI)
